1.body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Product Design Intern position at Bundul, specifically drawn to how the platform simplifies subscription management and 15-day split-payment scheduling.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability. At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time for corporate communications and digital assets.

You can review my B2B UX case study, Bounceless, which demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick fifteen-minute call next week to discuss how my background in wireframing and design systems aligns with your mobile app roadmap?

Ananya
